title: Llm Routing Layer
motto: Provider lock-in is expensive. Different tool-calling workloads suit different models. Routing gateways give one API surface, retries, failover, cost tracking, and guardrails. Three archetypes dominate 2026: LiteLLM (open-source self-hosted), OpenRouter (managed SaaS), Portkey (production-grade, open-sourced in March 2026). This lesson names the decision criteria and walks a stdlib routing gateway.

steps.title: The problem
cards: 1. **Cost.** Claude Sonnet costs 3x what Haiku costs. For a triage task, Haiku is enough; for a synthesis task, Sonnet is worth it. Route per-request.
2. **Failover.** OpenAI has a bad hour. Every request fails. You want automatic fallback to Anthropic without redeploying.
